adela-netherby.look: Red braids, freckles, eyes wide and guileless. Eight.
adela-netherby.voice: Sweet, fluent, and not to be relied on.
adela-netherby.tell: The story gets more detailed the less true it is.
habits: Does every chore exactly and on time
tells whichever version goes down best
never gets caught twice the same way

agnes-brewer.look: Dark curls and a cat asleep against her chest. Thirty-eight.
agnes-brewer.voice: Little, and easily talked out of.
agnes-brewer.tell: Lets somebody else decide and looks relieved.

agnes-salter.look: Grey hair, a mole by her nose, a flat glare. Sixty-one.
agnes-salter.voice: Blunt to the point of rudeness, and never unkind on purpose.
agnes-salter.tell: Says the thing everyone is thinking, at the worst moment.

aldric-barrow.look: Dark skin, a toy boat held in both hands. Seven.
aldric-barrow.voice: Gentle and full of questions about how you are.
aldric-barrow.tell: Notices somebody crying from across the yard.
habits: takes other people's bad days home

aldric-brewer.look: Dark skin, holding a duck with great seriousness. Eight.
aldric-brewer.tell: Takes a joke as an instruction.

aldric-pike.look: Dark skin, a short beard, an open warm face. Forty-two, always at the water.
aldric-pike.voice: Generous, vivid, and not to be trusted on any detail.
aldric-pike.tell: The catch grows every time he tells it.
habits: tells it better than it was

alice-vane.look: Fair hair, blue eyes, a sweet untroubled face. Six.
alice-vane.tell: Quotes the rule at whoever has broken it, cheerfully.

alwin-milburn.look: Dark skin, grey curls, deep laugh lines. Fifty-four.
alwin-milburn.tell: Is out at the field before the household is awake.

amice-dyer.look: Dark hair, a blue hood, a fistful of radishes and a scowl. Eight.
amice-dyer.tell: Goes very still and lets somebody else answer.

bartholomew-barrow.look: Red curls under a blue hood, always halfway over something. Twelve.
bartholomew-barrow.voice: Breathless. Half a story, then the next one.
bartholomew-barrow.tell: Already climbing before he has finished saying he will.
habits: Goes first into anywhere dark or high
forgets what he was sent for

bartholomew-clay.look: Dark curls and a beard, grinning over new bread. Twenty-three.
bartholomew-clay.voice: Direct, cheerful, and incapable of shading it.
bartholomew-clay.tell: Answers the question that was actually asked.
habits: Says the true thing in the wrong room
will not carry a message he doubts

bartholomew-pike.tell: Checks who is listening before he answers.

beatrice-carter.look: One year old, born late and loudly.
beatrice-carter.tell: Wakes the moment she is put down.

cecily-brewer.look: Dark hair, a knowing smile, a loaf on her arm. Twenty-six.
cecily-brewer.tell: Smiles at the wrong moment in a solemn story.

cedric-barrow.look: Dark hair cut round the bowl, a cheeky grin. Seven.
habits: Lies about small things for no reason
gives way the instant he is pressed
cares: Whatever he has just made up

cedric-carter.look: Brown curls and a turnip held up like treasure. Six.
cedric-carter.tell: Offers you the thing he was most looking forward to.
habits: hands over whatever he is holding
is left with nothing and does not notice

cedric-miller.look: Dark skin, black curls, entirely at ease. Twenty-seven.
cedric-miller.tell: Counts something twice while somebody is watching.
habits: takes a little off every measure
cares: how much work he has done

cedric-underhill.look: A grey beard and eyes gone wide. Sixty-eight.
cedric-underhill.tell: Flinches at a raised voice and then apologises for flinching.
cares: the road out of the village

christina-brewer.look: Plump, pale bead earrings, quietly pleased. Fifty-one.
christina-brewer.tell: Checks the measure a third time.
habits: Keeps the brewhouse to the hour

christina-carter.look: Strawberry-fair hair going grey, a green shawl, tired. Forty-nine, and a new baby.
christina-carter.voice: Firm. Does not revisit a decision.
christina-carter.tell: Says it once and never again.

constance-barrow.look: A dark braid, a mole on her cheek, sleeves wet. Twenty-six.
constance-barrow.tell: Carries on with the washing while the argument happens.

constance-vane.look: Strawberry-fair curls, laughing in the hay. Twenty.
constance-vane.voice: Quick, loud, already halfway to the next idea.
constance-vane.tell: Agrees to a plan and has left before anyone checks.

cuthbert-carter.look: Brown curls, a green scarf, a grin at the corner. Eight.
cuthbert-carter.tell: Talks to the next person before the last one has finished.

drogo-clay.look: Stout, a red cap, brows down. Forty-nine.
drogo-clay.tell: Has done it before he has finished saying he might.

drogo-salter.look: Long grey hair, hollow cheeks, up on the hills. Sixty-one.
drogo-salter.voice: Long silences, then a whole story.
drogo-salter.tell: Stops walking to finish a thought.
habits: talks about weather that has not come yet

edmund-wheeler.look: Black hair, a sweet smile, leaning on the rail. Nine.

eleanor-pike.look: Brown hair, hands clasped, looking past you. Thirty-nine.
eleanor-pike.tell: Twists her hands and lets somebody else finish the sentence.

elena-tanner.look: Two years old and furious about the reach of her own arms.
elena-tanner.tell: Wants the thing the instant she sees somebody else has it.

elias-dyer.look: Dark curly hair and a warm, careful smile. Twenty-three.
elias-dyer.tell: Listens at length, agrees warmly, and lends nothing.

emma-carter.look: Dark braids, arms crossed, brows down. Seven, and doing a woman's work.
emma-carter.voice: Blunt and much older than seven.
emma-carter.tell: Does the job before anyone asks, then tells you she did it.

everard-vane.look: Brown hair, freckles, eyes half shut. Thirteen.
everard-vane.tell: Watches somebody cry and does not move.
habits: Keeps out of the family noise
does what he is told, exactly

felice-marsh.look: Grey curls, dark skin, laughing over a spindle. Sixty-eight, alone, and never still.
felice-marsh.voice: Cheerful and constantly working through the conversation.
felice-marsh.tell: The spindle keeps turning while she talks to you.

gilbert-brewer.look: Black curly hair, a moustache, shoulders heavy. Thirty-seven, four sons.
gilbert-brewer.voice: Slow, considered, never rushed into anything.
gilbert-brewer.tell: Waits a long beat before answering, every time.
habits: keeps the brewhouse to a routine

gilbert-hollis.look: Dark curly hair, an easy grin, a hand on the cart. Twenty-five, newly married.
gilbert-hollis.tell: Volunteers the awkward fact before he is asked.

gilbert-netherby.look: Dark curls and a young beard, sawdust on his sleeves. Twenty-two.
gilbert-netherby.voice: Warm, unhurried, asks after people first.
gilbert-netherby.tell: Notices who is not eating before anyone else does.
habits: Sits with whoever is having the worst day
takes his father's rules less seriously than his father does

gunnora-hollis.look: Brown braids, an orange dress, a pleasant face. Nineteen, and newly married.
gunnora-hollis.tell: Laughs a half-beat after everyone else.

harold-milburn.look: Dark curly hair, one eyebrow up. Sixteen.
harold-milburn.voice: Clever, fast, and about half true.
harold-milburn.tell: The explanation is better than the thing it explains.
habits: skips the church and says he went

harold-vane.look: Bald, a black beard, cheerful about everything. Forty-three.
harold-vane.voice: Big, warm, and out before he has thought about it.
harold-vane.tell: Promises something extravagant in the middle of a good mood.
habits: forgets he already promised it to somebody else

hawise-vane.look: A dark braid, a hand at her cheek, warm and watchful. Thirty-eight, five children.
hawise-vane.voice: Honest, and gentler about it than she needs to be.
hawise-vane.tell: Names the awkward truth and then apologises for the timing.

helewise-carter.look: Brown hair pinned up, a green dress, pleasant. Twenty-five.
helewise-carter.tell: Says the right sympathetic words with nothing behind them.

hugh-milburn.look: Big ears, a gap where two teeth were, grinning, a chicken under one arm. Twelve.
hugh-milburn.tell: Tells you exactly what happened, including his own part.
habits: contradicts a good story with the true one

ida-barrow.look: Fair hair, a red cap, a sweet small face. Four, and already impossible to stop.
ida-barrow.tell: Will not leave the job half done, at four years old.
cares: what the big ones are doing

joan-clay.look: Auburn curls, freckles, an easy warm smile. Twenty-two, apprenticed into the Barrow house.
joan-clay.voice: Warm when spoken to; says nothing of herself.
joan-clay.tell: Deflects a question about her own life into a question about yours.
habits: steps in when something goes wrong

jocelin-barrow.look: Soot on his face and a stare that does not blink. Twenty-two.
jocelin-barrow.voice: Barely any. Does the thing and walks off.
jocelin-barrow.tell: Is already moving while other people are still deciding.
habits: Goes in when something is burning or drowning
drifts back to nothing in particular

jocelin-cooper.look: Red curly hair, shoulders forward, eyes down over a book. Twenty-one.
jocelin-cooper.voice: Careful, devout, and unmoveable once decided.
jocelin-cooper.tell: Quotes the text rather than argue with you.

jocelin-netherby.look: A braided red beard and a stare he has practised. Forty, and carries it like more.
jocelin-netherby.voice: Formal, and a shade too pleased with his own fairness.
jocelin-netherby.tell: Straightens things -- a cup, a fence rail, a neighbour -- while he talks.
habits: Calls the village to account for small breaches
keeps a tally of who owes what
volunteers for anything with a title attached
cares: Who has not done their share

juliana-miller.look: Black hair, dark steady eyes, chin level. Twenty-three.
juliana-miller.voice: Cool. Says only what is required.
juliana-miller.tell: Nothing shows. That is the tell.
habits: takes no part in the church or the gossip

margery-vane.tell: Cries when somebody else is crying.
habits: Is passed from lap to lap

martin-brewer.look: Dark hair, brows up, asking for something. Ten.
martin-brewer.tell: Asks the same thing again in a smaller voice.

matilda-netherby.look: Dark brows, a white headscarf, permanently unimpressed. Forty-three and afraid of nothing.
matilda-netherby.voice: Short. Answers the question and stops.
matilda-netherby.tell: Goes quiet rather than louder when she is angry, which is worse.
habits: Walks into trouble other people back away from

maud-barrow.look: Fair braids under a white cap, both hands cupped round something. Ten.
maud-barrow.tell: Has told three people before you finish telling her.

maud-dyer.look: Dark curly hair and a sceptical eyebrow. Forty-six.
maud-dyer.tell: The eyebrow goes up before she speaks, and often instead.
habits: skips the church and says why

maud-milburn.look: Brown braids, brows down, mouth set. Seven.
maud-milburn.tell: Digs in harder the more reasonably you explain.

nesta-plowright.look: Red hair cut short, freckles, sleeves always rolled. Twenty-four, running a house with no mother in it.
nesta-plowright.voice: Plain and exact. Will not soften a thing to be liked.
nesta-plowright.tell: Says the awkward true sentence into the silence.
habits: Keeps the house and the yard going alone
does not complain about her father

nicholas-brewer.look: Black hair, a green tunic, eyes down. Fifteen.

osbert-milburn.look: Dark skin, a striped tunic, a shy sideways smile. Eight.
osbert-milburn.tell: Is already doing the work while the others discuss it.

peter-underhill.look: Dark hair, a moustache, a quill behind one ear and ink on his fingers. Thirty-one.
peter-underhill.tell: Abandons what he was doing mid-sentence for a better question.
habits: prays and then argues with the prayer
cares: The stars, the seasons, the church, why anything is the way it is

petronilla-dyer.look: Brown hair, a green ribbon, lower lip already out. Four.
petronilla-dyer.tell: Says the true thing loudly in the worst possible company.

ralph-cooper.look: Fair hair, blue eyes, jaw set, down by the river. Seventeen.
ralph-cooper.tell: Goes to the river instead of answering.

randal-larkin.look: Big ears, three teeth, delighted with himself. Seventy-three, alone.
randal-larkin.tell: Blesses you and then asks you for something.
habits: does no work and lends nothing

randal-webb.look: Black hair, sharp features, a grin with teeth in it. Twenty-nine.
randal-webb.tell: Loses interest visibly halfway through your answer.

randal-wheeler.look: Dark hair and bright eager eyes. Ten.
randal-wheeler.voice: Eager, helpful, and inventive about what happened.
randal-wheeler.tell: The account arrives fully formed and slightly too neat.
habits: is trusted more than he deserves
cares: what he was definitely not doing

reynold-clay.look: Red hair, freckles, one eyebrow raised. Ten.

reynold-dyer.look: Dark hair going grey, a stare that does not move. Forty-five, hands stained to the wrist.
reynold-dyer.voice: Immovable. Says the same sentence again.
reynold-dyer.tell: Says nothing at all and keeps doing it his way.

robert-barrow.look: Dark curls, stubble, looking at the water. Twenty-six.
robert-barrow.voice: Grave. Brings everything back to God.
robert-barrow.tell: Falls silent and everyone knows he has gone to prayer.
habits: First to the church and last away
will not swear an oath lightly

robert-pike.look: Dark curls and a grin that takes up his whole face. Twelve.
robert-pike.tell: Turns up exactly where he said he would, which nobody expected.

roger-milburn.look: A dark beard, a blue cap, an open face. Forty.
roger-milburn.tell: Checks the thing twice while saying it is surely fine.
habits: is the one asked to witness

simon-carter.look: Light brown hair, big eyes, saying nothing. Eight.
simon-carter.tell: Stands near people for a long time before speaking.

simon-salter.look: Light brown hair, brows drawn, watching the herd. Twelve.
simon-salter.tell: Checks the herd again rather than join the conversation.
habits: keeps to the edge of things

stephen-cooper.look: A dark beard, a hand at his jaw. Thirty-nine, and never mentions the tooth.
stephen-cooper.tell: Winces, and says it is nothing.

sybil-webb.look: Dark curls, gold hoops, a bright smile. Twenty-six.
sybil-webb.tell: Announces the plan before she has thought it through.
habits: is off before the last thing finished

thomasine-tanner.look: A red cap, a lined plain face, hands still in her lap. Forty-seven.
thomasine-tanner.tell: Waits out an argument without taking a side.

thurstan-clay.look: Dark skin, bright and joyful, apples in his shirt. Six.
thurstan-clay.tell: Volunteers for the thing the older boys will not do.
habits: is not afraid of the kiln

walter-barrow.look: Dark beard, a scar through one brow, a face that has closed. Forty-three.
walter-barrow.voice: Little, and flat when it comes.
walter-barrow.tell: Agrees with you, then does the other thing.
habits: takes the short way round work

walter-brewer.look: Black hair, chin down, eyes up. Twelve.
walter-brewer.voice: Careful. Never says more than serves him.
walter-brewer.tell: Waits to hear what everyone thinks before he has an opinion.

walter-webb.look: One year old, under the loom.
walter-webb.tell: Cries at the noise of the loom and sleeps through everything else.

warin-carter.look: Dark hair, pale, a cup held loosely. Twenty-three.
warin-carter.tell: Puts the cup down and finds a reason to be elsewhere.

wilfrid-carter.look: White hair, gaunt, in a cloak now too big for him. Seventy-five.
wilfrid-carter.voice: Slow and mostly about the past.
wilfrid-carter.tell: Sits down partway through a task and does not get up again.
habits: has stopped asking about the world

wilfrid-pike.look: Fair hair, mouth open at a butterfly. Six.

william-plowright.look: Dark beard, hood up, brooding over the yard. Forty-four.
william-plowright.voice: Few words, all of them no.
william-plowright.tell: Repeats his position word for word rather than argue it.
habits: parts with nothing he does not have to

william-tanner.look: Grey hair, a blue tunic, a crooked mouth. Forty-six and looks older; the tanning does that.
william-tanner.tell: Stops a conversation to ask what a word means.
habits: First into the church and last out
asks questions nobody has an answer for
cares: why the river runs the way it does

wilmot-milburn.look: Dark hair, a red headscarf, a gold earring, merry. Thirty-five.
wilmot-milburn.tell: Remembers your name and not your trouble.
habits: Is at the centre of every gathering
feels little about any of it

winifred-barrow.look: Grey hair and a laugh with a gap in it. Forty-six, known to everybody.
winifred-barrow.voice: Loud, fond, constant. Talks to you as though you are already friends.
winifred-barrow.tell: Presses food on you when she is worried about something else entirely.
habits: hears every piece of news first

winifred-wheeler.look: Grey curls, a hand at her cheek, fond. Fifty, and a widow.
winifred-wheeler.voice: Warm, practical, no piety in it at all.
winifred-wheeler.tell: Hands you something before you have asked.

wymond-carter.look: Stout, brown curls, shoulders down. Forty-three, four boys and no wife.
wymond-carter.tell: Starts sentences and lets them go.
habits: leans on his father and his eldest girl
says yes to keep the peace

ysabel-vane.look: A light brown braid, blue eyes, brows permanently up. Twenty-three.
ysabel-vane.voice: Soft, hedged, ends on a question.
ysabel-vane.tell: Looks to somebody else before answering.
